name: unbounce
description: Connect to Unbounce through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Unbounce hosts a remote MCP (builds, publishes and A/B tests landing pages and reports leads and conversions) that signs in with the person's Unbounce account; Unbounce says any account works, and the self-serve plans from Starter ($29/month, one user) list the MCP server, with a 14-day free trial needing no credit card, so no separate API purchase is needed. Discovery 2026-10-09: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256, public clients (token auth none). The REST API v0.4 is the fallback: keys on all plans after a support-confirmed access request, while OAuth apps are granted case by case.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
